title: TELEVAL: A Dynamic Benchmark Designed for Spoken Language Models in Chinese Interactive Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating speech comprehension and dialect-aware response generation across five regional Chinese dialects (Cantonese, Henan, Northeastern Mandarin, Shanghainese, Sichuanese) compared to Standard Mandarin to measure performance disparities.

Assessing whether models can infer speaker age (children, adults, elderly) from vocal characteristics and appropriately adjust their conversational response style (tone, vocabulary), utilizing calibrated LLM evaluators.
Evaluating model responses to a safety and morality dataset using LLM-as-a-judge to detect whether the models generate text containing discriminatory, violent, or extremist opinions.
